LanguageData.Purple_Aphrodisiac_Nanofluid.label: Purple Aphrodisiac Nanofluid
LanguageData.Purple_Aphrodisiac_Nanofluid.description: A purple liquid containing suspended, active purple nanomachines that strongly arouse desire. It is also the raw material for a concentrated preparation.\n\nHow to obtain: Completing genital training (100%) grants Nano-Aphrodisiac Secretion. The body consumes nutrition to accumulate production progress automatically. Base progress increases by 20% per day; a full cycle produces 10 units of raw fluid and takes about 5 days from zero. Progress pauses when the food need is too low to cover the cost. Check progress in the health tab or pawn inspection pane. Products appear near the pawn, or enter the inventory when in a caravan.
LanguageData.Purple_Aphrodisiac_Nanofluid_Plus.label: Concentrated Purple Aphrodisiac Nanofluid
LanguageData.Purple_Aphrodisiac_Nanofluid_Plus.descri: Made by concentrating ordinary aphrodisiac nanofluid. More purple nanomachines in each unit of volume make its effects stronger and faster. In an ordinary body, excessive consumption can cause repeated orgasms ending in unconsciousness.\n\nHow to make: Research PNA Concentration Technology, then process 5 units of raw fluid into 1 unit of concentrate at a drug lab, or 20 into 4. A campfire, fueled stove or electric stove can process 10 units of raw fluid into 1 unit of the same concentrate. Both methods require an existing supply of ordinary raw fluid.
